# Soy Mestiza

## About
Soy Mestiza is an Argentine wine brand born from the award-winning theatrical production "Como el vino, Soy Mestiza" (Carlos de Oro winner, Villa Carlos Paz season). The brand fuses flamenco, Arabic music, folklore, and tango — the same cultural fusion that defines the theatrical production.

Founded by Mariana Clemenceau (creator and lead performer) and Adriana Allendes.

## Products
High-altitude wines from Calingasta, San Juan, Argentina (±1,400 m above sea level), elaborated at a winery in Mendoza, Argentina.
- Malbec (Alta Cuyo, Calingasta)
- Cabernet (Alta Cuyo, Calingasta)
- Rosé (coming soon)

Premium bottles with illustrated labels based on the theatrical costumes, featuring stamping and relief printing.

## Awards & Recognition
- Carlos de Oro — Theatrical award, Villa Carlos Paz season

## Legal
This site contains information about alcoholic beverages. Minimum age: 18 years. Argentina — Ley 24.788.
"Beber con moderación. Prohibida su venta a menores de 18 años."
